    Make your move

    SHIFT / B uses nitrous. Q / X slows the action with Speedbreaker.

  4. 04

    Finish your line

    Circuit: pass every checkpoint. Pursuit: break contact with patrols. R / Y recovers your car on the road. ESC / START pauses.

    Brake before tight corners. Tap the handbrake to rotate. Hold Q to slow the action and sharpen steering. Nitrous recharges while moving. Circuit requires every checkpoint in order. Pursuit: after 20 seconds, stay more than 120 m from patrols for eight seconds to escape. Four seconds below 18 km/h near a patrol means a bust.

    THE MAKING OF HARBOR RUN

    Made for the open road.

    Five original vehicles and a day/night forest and alpine kit authored from scratch in Blender for Harbor Run. Editable scenes and reproducible scripts are included in the source package.

    The supplied Hot Pursuit footage informed silhouettes, forest highways, wet asphalt and alpine scenery. This is an original approximation of those visual references and circuit, with no extracted game models or downloaded vehicle meshes.

    Asphalt 01 and Kloofendal partly cloudy daylight from Poly Haven, CC0. Scenery geometry, needle foliage and other material maps are original. Barlow and Barlow Condensed: SIL Open Font License. Renderer: Three.js, MIT. Interface, game logic and sound are original.

    Circuit: two laps, three rivals and traffic. Pursuit: up to three interceptor patrols, reinforcements, escape and bust outcomes. Each of the five machines has an original arcade driving setup. Career progression remains future work.
    Use a keyboard or gamepad to drive.
